question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?

nodes.text: ...And a few hours later, a beautiful tree house was completed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Done and done!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And not a moment too soon.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! We already booked our first showing.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Chip.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, Chip, so right in front, we have the foyer. Note the windows. They let in lots of light...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But the sills are lined with spikes to keep `out` the ninjas.
nodes.text_bbcode: But the sills are lined with spikes to keep [color=#3b78e2][i]out[/i][/color] the ninjas.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Ooh, good feature.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And to the left of the entranceway, you'll note the E-Z Cook Oven. It comes pre-loaded with chocolate chip cookies...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And it's rigged to detonate if anybody but you tries to mess with it!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hm, what about those floors? Is that real plywood?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Except for the trapdoor. That's made from a playground slide and barb wire.
Now Chip's family might not've had enough money to buy a tree house themselves, but Chip did his part to talk up the design.
And soon enough, orders were flooding in.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Steve, but as I've already explained, we've got a six week waiting list. If you want to put down a deposit, we'll pencil you in as soon as we can.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Great. And yes, I'll be sure to let you know if there are any cancellations...
By the time our father called the next family meeting, their little tree house building company had blossomed into a thriving enterprise.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Children, I want you to know that I've given this decision a great deal of thought, and I've come to the conclusion...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...That we're staying!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I've spoken to my superiors, and they've allowed me to stay in Centerscore provided I accept a five percent reduction in salary...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...Which I plan to recoup by becoming a full-partner in Kay and Kel's successful new business venture.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're not really big on sharing, but still...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're happy to be home!
And I was happy to be home too... Because Centerscore was where I'd meet the girl who would change my love life forever.
...And a few hours later, I'd barely made any progress at all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So wait... Is that a porch or a veranda? And how am I supposed to install an indoor swimming pool in a tree?
It was at that moment that Kay and Kel ran up. They were panicked and out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh, Howard, are you done yet?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Because there's something we should maybe tell you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It turns out that the guy we borrowed all this wood and equipment from is coming over...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And he's a little upset 'cause of how we didn't tell him we were borrowing it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Hey, there they are, officer! Those kids raided my lumber yard.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Run!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Wait for...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Freeze! You're under arrest for stealing lumber!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me?! But... But I didn't steal anything! It was Kay and Kel!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Huh, now that ya mention it, the person who robbed my lumber yard was a little shorter, and he did have a bow in his hair...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: And he did kinda look like he was two people instead of just da one.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: But you're da guy standing here with all my stolen lumber.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Officer, arrest this man!
...And arrested I was.
By the time my father called the next family meeting, my family was deep in debt from paying restitution to Mr. Lumbar for all the stolen lumber.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Children, I want you to know that I've given this decision a great deal of thought, and I've come to the conclusion...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: That we're moving to Europe.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now I know that some of you might not have wanted to leave, but Howard's irresponsible behavior has driven us to flee our native land.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But dad, it was Kay and Kel who...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What did I tell you, son? Don't do the time, if you're just going to whine!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now man up and pack your things!
As sad as I was then, it turned out that the decision to leave America would actually put me in the `right place...`
nodes.text_bbcode: As sad as I was then, it turned out that the decision to leave America would actually put me in the [b]right place...[/b]

nodes.text: At the `right time...`
nodes.text_bbcode: At the [b]right time...[/b]

nodes.text: To meet the girl who would change my love life forever... Well, kind of.
But that isn't where this part of the story ends...
While my parents were busy figuring out the logistics of a possible move...
I'd been tasked to keep an eye on my twin sisters, Kay and Kel, and supervise their new business venture.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We want to build `tree houses` for all the neighboring kids. We think they'll pay lots of money to get one.
nodes.text_bbcode: We want to build [color=#3b78e2][i]tree houses[/i][/color] for all the neighboring kids. We think they'll pay lots of money to get one.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But first, we need a showroom model... Here are the blueprints. Make sure you don't leave out anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second. You want `me` to build your tree house?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second. You want [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] to build your tree house?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Duh... We're what you call 'above the line' talent.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Besides we're not old enough to use power tools.
Having nothing better to do, I decided to help out, using the pile of lumber that Kay and Kel provided as materials.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, why not? Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: A life? Please. You know what a life is, son?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: A life is a wife, three kids, a mortgage, and a job that thinks it can slide you around like a shuffleboard on the cold, cruel deck of the cruise ship of fate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Life is pain. And at the end of it, you get a gold watch and a swift kick out the door!
With that, my father stormed out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What were you thinking, Howard? Why did you upset your father like that? Couldn't you see he's stressed enough already?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Mom, I... I guess if we have to move, that'll be okay.
Honestly, I still didn't want to move, but I knew then that nothing I could say would change my father's mind one way or the other.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I know, son, and I know they mean a lot to you.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: But I'm not blind, either. I also know this past year has been pretty hard on you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, it has.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I want you to know that I'll do everything I can to keep the family here, but if we do have to move...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Maybe, just maybe, a fresh start could do you some good. Think about that for me, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... I hadn't thought about it like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Great talk. Now who wants to go out for fish tacos?
Now, I still didn't want to move, but it felt really good to know that my father was taking my feelings into consideration...
...And I had every reason to hope that things would work out for the best.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Children, I called this family meeting to inform you that my work has asked me to take a supervisory position at the new branch office opening in Europe.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now, no decisions have been made at this time, but your mother thought you should be made aware of the situation.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course, I did! This is really big news. You can't just spring something like this at the last possible second.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Says the woman who waited nine months to tell me she was pregnant.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You looked busy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, moving to Europe...? Seriously?!
Now I'd visited Europe the previous summer, and I knew from experience it was a pretty nice place...
Even if the girls there did tend to hurl scalding-hot coffee in people's faces.
But regardless, I had no intention of moving there.
That's why I told my father...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Dad, we can't move. I have...
I expected my whole summer would go exactly the same way, but then... My father called a family meeting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, guys, all of my plans involved Linda. Now that she and Kenji are officially sucking face, I've got nothing to do...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nothing to do? Nothing to do?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did Neil Armstrong land on the moon and radio back that he had 'Nothing to do'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did Christopher Columbus reach the New World and then give up right before Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, that was the Pilgrims, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't pay attention in History class, do you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, dogg, my point is this.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've got your two best buds right here, and we promise to keep you neck deep in beach blasts and backyard barbeques all summer.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard... Wicca rituals are great, but summer is the perfect time to catch really big action movies. We can go together!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, thanks guys!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're the best!
Because I'd been honest with my friends that day, I spent the first few weeks of the summer doing cannonballs at beach parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Geronimo!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it! You'll scare the guppies!
...And checking out awesome summer action movies!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so let me get this straight...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nicolai Cale is a powerful sorcerer who can do absolutely anything, but instead, he uses his magic to drive sports cars through plate glass windows?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, this is way lame. I mean, if I wanted to see a bunch of dudes shooting fireballs from their hands, I'd get Travis to siphon gas from his truck again.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Actually, guys, Dinah was telling me that the spells they use in this film are derived from authentic Enochian divinations and...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Would you please be quiet! I'm trying to take notes!
Yep, it was a great couple of weeks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, not to brag or anything, but I'll be taking a little Caribbean cruise to a remote tropical island...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where I'll help a hot female primatologist teach an orphaned capuchin monkey how to forage for coconuts... Using, um, a jetpack!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've almost got it, Bobo. Just remember to use your sideboard thrusters to control your yaw and pitch.
Bobo nods in agreement.

nodes.speaker: Scientist
nodes.text: Exceptional work, Howard. I don't think Bobo would've survived if you hadn't decided to spend your summer with us.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Doc!

nodes.speaker: Scientist
nodes.text: Hm, the sun sure is bright today. Maybe you should rub some suntan lotion on my shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you insist!

nodes.speaker: Scientist
nodes.text: Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that about sums up my plans.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So you'll be gone all summer?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I mean, not `all summer`, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I mean, not [color=#e23b3b][i]all summer[/i][/color], but...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow. That's good to hear. Brendan and I were really worried that your break-up with Linda would spoil all your vacation plans.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, we were afraid you'd spend the whole summer at home playing `MineFinder.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we were afraid you'd spend the whole summer at home playing [color=#e23b3b][i]MineFinder.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anyway, now that we know you're taken care of, we're clear to spend the whole summer making out with our girlfriends.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, but that was actually a...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw, nevermind.
Because I'd lied to my friends, I actually did spend the first few weeks of summer at home playing MineFinder by myself...

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Beep! Beep! Ka-Boom! The mine exploded! You lost a limb!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Air-lifting to hospital to receive prosthetic.

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Hospital is out of prosthetics due to a plastic shortage caused by the global recession.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh... This new version of MineFinder is way too depressing.
Yep. It was a terrible couple of weeks...
Unbeknownst to me, a series of seemingly random choices would soon put me in the right place...
At `the right time...`
nodes.text_bbcode: At [b]the right time...[/b]

nodes.text: To meet `the right girl...`
nodes.text_bbcode: To meet [b]the right girl...[/b]

nodes.text: ...A girl who would change my love life forever.
Now before we get to the choices I made, I need to set the stage...
As school ended that year, my friends were in high spirits...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! Last day of school!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Starting tomorrow, no more homework to get in the way of killer make-out sessions with Amanda. We're gonna be lip-locked 24-7!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm excited too! Dinah is taking me to a Wicca summoning ritual in the forest!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How do you summon a Wicca?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know. I figure it's like the 'Raising of Rokkjarr' instance in `Warscrewdriver: Online...` But with fewer orcs.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know. I figure it's like the 'Raising of Rokkjarr' instance in [color=#e23b3b][i]Warscrewdriver: Online...[/i][/color] But with fewer orcs.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What about you, H-dogg?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard. Got any plans?
Now the truth is I had made plans a few months ago... Really super awesome plans, to go to the beach with my then-girlfriend Linda!
Of course, that was before Linda dumped me and broke my heart.
Back then, I'd been expecting a summer like this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're looking a little hot there, Linda. Perhaps I should rub some suntan lotion on your shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Tee hee.
But obviously, when Linda broke up with me and started dating Kenji, the reality turned out a bit more like this...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're looking a little crispy, babe. How about I glob some suntan lotion on your back, then smear it around like a finger-painting gorilla?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Tee hee.
Okay, so that last part was made up, but it's definitely how I felt about the situation.
It also explains why, when I was talking to my friends, I decided to...
With lightning fast reflexes, I dodged the muddy water.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, that was close.
And in that moment, I could tell that things were finally beginning to look up!
And I was right!
The muddy water drenched me from head to toe, working its way into the fabric of my rented tux.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh. There goes the deposit.
And in that moment, I knew that I really had hit rock bottom.
Fortunately, that meant there was nowhere to go but up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh. There goes the deposit.
And in that moment, I knew that I really had hit rock bottom.
Fortunately, that meant there was nowhere to go but up!
The muddy water drenched me from head to toe, working its way into the fabric of my rented tux.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ugh. There goes the deposit.
And in that moment, I knew that I really had hit rock bottom.
Fortunately, that meant there was nowhere to go but up!
I caught the football. I strolled effortlessly into the End Zone.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... No fair, Coach. Howard is way too fast.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You just be glad he's on our team, son.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Good work, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right, everyone, did you see that? `That` was real football.
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, everyone, did you see that? [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was real football.

nodes.text: Now despite my winning performance on the field, there was one freshman who didn't seem impressed.
His name was Lucas, and he wanted my spot on the team.
He also wasn't shy about letting that fact be known.

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard might've done a pretty good job today, but he's definitely not all that.
I threw myself at Lucas!
We rolled on the ground, each of us getting in a few cheap jabs... Until Coach intervened.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Now what in the Sam Hill is going on here? Who started this?

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: He did! We were just talking, and then Howard attacked me! He's like totally crazy!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Is that right, son?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, yes... I mean, no...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, it wasn't out of nowhere. Lucas made fun of me first and then...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Howard. I really am.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Unfortunately, the Athletic Department has a zero tolerance policy regarding fighting.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: As of right now, you're off the team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: No buts... Just clean out your locker and go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen here, Froshy Flakes. You're talking trash, but I don't see you doing any better with the ladies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So tell us, which girl are you dating?

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I've got this one girl... She lives in Canada, but...
Immediately, the football team erupted in derisive laughter.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha! Do you hear that? Lucas here has a `Canadian girlfriend!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Do you hear that? Lucas here has a [color=#e23b3b][i]Canadian girlfriend![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Where'd you meet her? `Camp?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Where'd you meet her? [color=#e23b3b][i]Camp?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Yeah, it was at camp, but...
As Lucas fumbled to explain himself, the laughter redoubled in intensity.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Stop it already, freshman. You're killing me!
And then a funny thing happened. Big, tough Lucas started to cry.

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: You guys are right... Sniff... I don't really have a girlfriend, and I'm sorry for what I said to you, Howard... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: It's just that I'm starting up at a new school, and I'm not very good at academics, so I was...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You were hoping to make a name for yourself playing football, right?

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Yeah, that was why I insulted you. I thought maybe by bringing you down, I'd get a chance to start this season.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that's not very cool, Lucas. We're supposed to be a `team.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's not very cool, Lucas. We're supposed to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]team.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... Believe it or not, I understand what you're going through. There was a time when I was gunning for starting position.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And back then, there was a guy on the team who helped me out, so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Lucas, if you want, I'd be happy to teach you what I know.

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: You would?! Really?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, I guess. I... I mean we'd have to meet up before school to practice, but...

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Thank you! Thank you, Howard! You won't regret this!
For the next few months, Lucas and I would show up to school early to work on passing drills.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go deep! Now break right!

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: I caught it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great job, Lucas.
Lucas was a quick learner, and he improved rapidly.
After I graduated, Lucas went on to become Centerscore High's star wide receiver. He even broke a few of my records.
But don't think I hold that against him. Nothing could be further from the truth.
You see, if it hadn't been for Lucas, I wouldn't have been at school at the `right time` to meet the girl who would change my love life forever.
nodes.text_bbcode: You see, if it hadn't been for Lucas, I wouldn't have been at school at the [b]right time[/b] to meet the girl who would change my love life forever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey? Who's that `new girl?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey? Who's that [color=#e23b3b][i]new girl?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: I let the football slip right through my fingers.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Come on, Howard. We both know I was going to win this game, but you made it way too easy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Listen up, freshmen. Did you see what Zach did out there? Now that was real high school football.
Looking back, I don't know why I played so badly that day. Maybe it was nerves, maybe it was stress...
All I know is that after that exhibition match, the freshmen football players never afforded me any respect.
That might've been why one freshman, a kid name Lucas, felt like he could trash talk me after practice.

nodes.speaker: Lucas
nodes.text: Did you see Howard out there today? Man needs a baked potato to go with those butter fingers.
Thanks to my father's decision to keep the family in Centerscore...
I was in the `right place` to meet the girl who would change my love life forever...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was in the [b]right place[/b] to meet the girl who would change my love life forever...

nodes.text: And soon, I would make a decision that would make sure I was there at the `right time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And soon, I would make a decision that would make sure I was there at the [b]right time.[/b]

nodes.text: Surprisingly, that decision had to do with football.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Listen up, you maggots. I hope you all enjoyed your summers, because as of this second, FUN IS OFFICIALLY DEAD!!!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: From now on, there is only work, work, and then... More glorious work! Got it?!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Now, for the benefit of our new players, I've prepared an exhibition match to demonstrate some real football.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Howard, you captain one team. Zach, you captain the other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We're ready, sir!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Us, too!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Okay then, hit the field.
Even though this was only an exhibition match, this game was very important because it would shape the perceptions of the incoming class.
From that moment on, either Zach or I would be recognized as the `star player.`
nodes.text_bbcode: From that moment on, either Zach or I would be recognized as the [b]star player.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Quarterback
nodes.text: Okay, everybody into formation... Ready and HIKE!!!

nodes.speaker: Quarterback
nodes.text: Howard, go long!
I raced down the field...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, we could do that.
Sam and I took to the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, you're a pretty good dancer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're not so bad yourself. Have you thought about trying out for the cheerleading squad?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why? Do you like cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure. I mean, they're fine, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I heard from Taylor that they don't have any openings on the squad right now, but once they do, I'll be sure to try out, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, sure. That sounds... Fine.
And that was pretty much how the evening went.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...So like I was saying, I just found out my cousin will be moving in with us. So totally unfair, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...
Sam was obviously very into me, and I was still trying to figure out how I felt about her.
But right then, I looked across the dance floor, and I saw...
...Linda, slow dancing with Kenji.
And I realized something very important...
Sure, Sam was into me, but she didn't make me feel like being with Linda did. She clearly wasn't the `right girl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, Sam was into me, but she didn't make me feel like being with Linda did. She clearly wasn't the [b]right girl.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for the dance, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, this was fun. So do you want to...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I think I'm done dancing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Was it something I said? I guess Howard's just not into me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Later?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm just not in a dancing mood at the moment, but maybe...

Thanks to my father's decision to stay in Centerscore, I was in the `right place` to meet the girl who would change my love life forever...

nodes.text: But I still had to make decisions to ensure I was meeting the `right girl!`

nodes.text: Now let's rewind for a second. This part of the story actually began a few days earlier in Drama Class.

nodes.text: Et tu, Brute? Then fall, Ceasar!
I'd enrolled in the drama elective because Brendan promised I'd get an easy `A...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd enrolled in the drama elective because Brendan promised I'd get an easy [b]A...[/b]

nodes.text: ...But I was definitely starting to have some second thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Very good, Brendan. That was highly dramatic.

Sam and I went to the Winter Formal together as `boyfriend and girlfriend.`

nodes.text: Hey! You're a pretty good dancer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're not so bad yourself! You should be a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... I was thinking about it, but there isn't an opening on the squad.
Little did Sam know... But the events that would unfold that night would actually give her just such an opportunity.
You see, it all started when Student Body President Scott unveiled his `special surprise:` a massive, professional snow ma...

nodes.text: And that eventually led to me finding a girlfriend!
One morning, after practicing football drills with Lucas, Hannah walked up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Howard, it's come to my attention that you got the male lead in the one-act play our school is performing for the Regional Schlockspeare festival.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I was pretty surprised I got it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever. I just wanted to inform you that we're dating now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... We are?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Duh, I always date my romantic lead. It's the only way to generate real chemistry on stage.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Drop by my house after school to practice making out, 'kay?
Now it might seem like getting kicked off the football team was a terrible thing, and it sure felt like it at the time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stupid... Stupid... Stupid...
But it actually ended up freeing my afternoons to pursue other extra-curricular activities.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Psst... Hey, Howard. I hear you're into fighting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, hey, Travis. Not really. I mean, I got in `one` fight, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hey, Travis. Not really. I mean, I got in [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] fight, but...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Well, if you ever decide you want to get into another, I know a place where you can make some real money...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... Are you talking about an illegal underground fighting ring?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Whoa, not so loud! Listen, bro, before we talk more, I need to know, are you in or out?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, it's not like I've got anything better to do now that I've been kicked off the football team.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: That's the spirit! I'm sure you'll do great!
Three months later, in France...
One night, my father invited his American co-worker and her husband over for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Look at him, honey. Isn't little Howard just adorable?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sure, quite a fine young man.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I bet he and our Zoe would've gotten along famously. Unfortunately, she stayed behind to live with her cousin when our family moved to Europe.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Zoe's going to a new school.... What was the name of it again?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Centerscore High School, I do believe.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! But that's where `I` used to go.
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! But that's where [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] used to go.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, that's right! What a coincidence!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Honey, go ahead and show Howard a picture of our little girl.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, I... Wow, she's... She's...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Look, dear. Howard's speechless!

nodes.title: When Howard Met...
nodes.subtitle: Help Howard meet his new crush!

nodes.text: Look at me.
See that guy in a rented tux there? That's me, sulking my way home after selling my Prom ticket to Dinah...
I'll be spending Prom night alone in my room...
You might be thinking that there's no way I could've been any more pathetic.
But just then, a limo veered around the corner.
Its tires skidded through a puddle, splashing muddy water right at me!
This is a quick choice.
The scene continued...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your town folk may now breathe easy, Genevieve. The outlaw Balthazar has been defeated.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He was eaten alive by his own trained attack crabs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the legends surrounding the scorpion medallion were true, as well.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: With the gold we recovered from the treasure vault, we can hire a salsa band for our August wedding!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: ...And scene! Great job, guys! That was really enjoyable!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you were really funny, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me? I thought you were the funny one!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, maybe we make a good team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you wanted to, we could practice more improvisation after school sometime.
In fact, you were `perfect!` Enjoy your special bonus scene.
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, you were [b]perfect![/b] Enjoy your special bonus scene.

nodes.text: Thanks to your quick wits, Howard was in the right place at the right time to meet a new romantic interest...
But chance has played a role in the start of other relationships, as well.
For instance, if the town of Centerscore hadn't received twenty million dollars targeted toward volcano relief...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, we've got to do something with all this money, don't we?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hm, I know! Let's have a parade and award $10,000 to the high school with the best float!
...And if Linda hadn't been on the Spirit Committee...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I know we don't have a ton of time on this project... But I trust you girls to make the best darn float you can!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We won't let you down!
...And if Howard hadn't suggested that the Auto-Shop kids might be willing to help Linda build the float in order to stick it to Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember last year, when the Centerscore Auto-Shop kids let four wild goats loose in the Wilson High locker room? That was hilarious!
...And if Hector hadn't run into Kenji at the Limo Depot before Prom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kenji! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm doing a little part-time work fixing up these limos. What are you guys here for?
...Then Linda and Kenji might never have gotten together!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I ran into Hector earlier today, and he said something that kind of got to me.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He said that if I didn't go to Prom, I'd regret it. I thought about that, and I realized it was true.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Not that I'd regret not going to Prom... But that I'd regret not going to Prom with `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that I'd regret not going to Prom... But that I'd regret not going to Prom with [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Linda... Will you be my Prom date?
But if even one tiny thing had happened differently...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: This is preposterous! Centerscore doesn't have any `volcanoes!` We couldn't possibly accept these relief funds.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is preposterous! Centerscore doesn't have any [color=#e23b3b][i]volcanoes![/i][/color] We couldn't possibly accept these relief funds.

nodes.text: ...Everything else would've happened differently too! Let's take a look at what might've been!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa... This is one crazy Prom. I mean, back when this school year started, I never thought I'd end up dating you, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really? I was sure I felt a spark when we wrote that newspaper article on Local Ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. There probably was something between us then, but it wasn't until you foiled the Prom Tiara heist that I knew for sure you were the girl for me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, we're hardly the most bizarre couple here. Take a look.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard is with Kat.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: What are you doing, Howie? Why are you looking over there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! I just saw them looking over here, and...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: And I suppose you look at `everybody` who looks at you? What kind of crazy cheating boyfriend are you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I suppose you look at [color=#3b78e2][i]everybody[/i][/color] who looks at you? What kind of crazy cheating boyfriend are you?!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It must've been those four months you spent locked up in Boot Camp that made you so cold and heartless.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dex is with Megan.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Beep! Beep! Our love is beyond computation!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Heh... You're a total dweeb, but you're my total dweeb. Besides, how could I resist a chance to date the winner of the Prince Prix?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spike is with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Who else would I date? Amanda is like a total genius at naming skateboarding tricks.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, babe... Say three words fast.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 720 Snorkle McFlip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, all those pairings do seem... Odd... Almost as if the world was supposed to be different somehow.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But anyway, we're getting distracted from the real issue.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Which is...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We're at Prom, Brendan. We should totally be making out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Brendan, did you just feel the earth move?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not like that. Look over there! There seems to be some kind of commotion.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! is that... `Lava?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! is that... [color=#e23b3b][i]Lava?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Run, children! A volcano has erupted! Ruuunnn!!!
Whoa... It looks like turning down those volcano relief funds was a big mistake!
It's good things didn't happen like that!
But even though chance may rule our lives, there is one thing you definitely don't want to leave up to chance!
